verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax's evidence documents automatic tax calculation, registration monitoring, reports, and TaxJar filing integration. None of it shows a user-definable rules engine that triggers actions when events occur. Built-in automatic tax behavior is an adjacent feature, not user-defined event-triggered rules, so the axis applies but has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
